name: Step-3.7-Flash

name: MiMo-V2-Flash

name: GLM-4.7
why: Strong official coding/agent evidence and mature dual-runtime support; main drawback is Q4 weight precision and faster KV growth.

why: The strongest dense candidate inside the band at Q6, but all 253B parameters participate and decode compute will be high.
